decisions.reason: Although adjacent to our construction equipment know-how, the construction site dumper appears less differentiated from competitors and draws resources away from niches where our engineering, safety and service knowledge can be applied more effectively.
The inclined furniture lift builds closely on our lifting, safety and service capabilities, so our existing knowledge base gives us good scope to interpret market feedback and improve the product.
The inclined building material lift fits our established strengths in specialized lifting equipment and after-sales support, making continued learning and commercial refinement relatively strong.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift combines vehicle integration and lifting technology that are both near our core competencies, so despite somewhat higher complexity it remains a product we can credibly develop and support.
